doc.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’m sure you’ll be here same time next year.
I hope so. I sincerely hope so. Can I bring my wife?
I think it’s okay. You both have behaved yourself very well.
Oh, yeah, it’s only Saturday afternoon.
Anyway it’s nice to talk to you, thank you.
Great pleasure. On behalf of the Hamilton College I thank you for joining us today. Have a good gig tonight.
Thank you. We’re going to try. Lord knows we’re going to try. Thank you. SR: [inaudible]
